Choose which controller you want to observe or test.
Activity only helps identify the controller; it does not change selection or move focus.
It looks like this controller disconnected. Reconnect it and start a new test.

Check buttons, D-pad and sticks step by step with a simple guide.
See exactly which inputs Android is receiving in real time.
Connect a controller to view its inputs.
Choose a controller to view its inputs.
This screen is informational only. It does not change button assignments.
Keep the controller still for a moment and hold it normally. We’ll start a fresh test.
Inputs used to navigate here do not count as test evidence.
Press the %1$s while CarePad is listening. Only that control counts for this step.
I tried it and it wasn’t detected
Start the attempt when you’re ready. We won’t mark anything missing just because no event arrived yet.
Listening to this attempt… Use the highlighted control now.
We haven’t seen that control yet. If you already tried it, you can say so.
Input received. Checking whether it matches the highlighted control…
Not detected after an explicit attempt.
Leave the left stick still and roughly centered before testing its movement.
Leave the right stick still and roughly centered before testing its movement.
This step only prepares the observation; it does not diagnose drift or require a perfect center.
Move the left stick in different directions and return it to center.
Move the right stick in different directions and return it to center.
We couldn’t interpret this stick reliably enough. It will be shown as Inconclusive, not as a fault.
Test complete. We didn’t see anything unusual in what we were able to check.
The test is complete, but there are a few things worth reviewing.
The result only describes what Android delivered during this test; it does not by itself certify the complete physical condition of the controller.
The test will remain incomplete. Evidence from this session is kept only while you stay inside this test.
Android does not expose compatible inputs to show for this controller.
